top_offers.title: AI Research Scientist / Engineer
top_offers.why: Geneva-based at SonarSource (SonarQube, SonarCloud) — one of the strongest product engineering cultures in the region and CHF salaries. The ML research depth required (PyTorch, RAG, fine-tuning) is a stretch beyond API integration, so a strong cover letter framing the 'ML practitioner vs. researcher' gap would be critical.
